title: Easy Breezy
intro: [excited] Hey hey, everybody! Today's board is Easy Breezy, made for the littlest Disney fans in the room. Every single clue is one the kids can get. [laughs] Grown-ups, this is your chance to get beaten by a seven-year-old.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny meadow party with giant colourful balloons, a picnic blanket, a toy castle made of building blocks, bubbles floating through the air, soft pastel sky.

categories.title: Let It Go
categories.intro: [excited] First up, a movie that every kid on Earth can sing from start to finish. Let It Go is all about Frozen!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sparkling ice palace on a snowy mountain under swirling green northern lights, glittering snowflakes in the air.

clues.clue: In Frozen, Anna's big sister has magical ice powers. What is her name?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elsa! [laughs] Queen of Arendelle, master of ice, and the reason every parent knows all the words to Let It Go.

clues.clue: This silly snowman in Frozen likes warm hugs and dreams about summer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Olaf! A snowman who loves summer. [chuckles] What could possibly go wrong?

clues.clue: Kristoff's best friend in Frozen is a reindeer with this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sven! [laughs] Kristoff even does Sven's voice for him. Reindeers are better than people, after all.

clues.clue: Anna and Elsa live in this snowy kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Arendelle! The kingdom is inspired by Norway, from the fjords to the wooden stave churches.

clues.clue: Finish Elsa's famous line from Let It Go: The cold never bothered me...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is anyway! [excited] And then she slams the door on her ice palace. Iconic.

categories.title: What Color Is It?
categories.intro: Grab your crayons, because this category is all about colors! Just tell me what color it is.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A giant open box of crayons spilling a rainbow of colours across a sunny playroom table, paint splatters and paper stars.

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse usually wears shorts of this bright color, with two white buttons.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is red! [excited] Red shorts, yellow shoes and white gloves. The most famous outfit in the world.

clues.clue: Lilo's alien buddy Stitch has fur that is mostly this color.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is blue! Experiment 626 is fluffy, blue and very, very naughty. [laughs]

clues.clue: In Toy Story, Rex the nervous dinosaur is this color.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is green! [chuckles] A big green dinosaur who is scared of almost everything.

clues.clue: Belle dances with the Beast in a sparkly ball gown of this color.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is yellow! Some call it gold. Either way, it's one of the most famous dresses in Disney history.

clues.clue: Peter Pan's tiny fairy friend Tinker Bell wears a little dress of this color.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is green! [whispers] Made out of leaves, and sprinkled with a little pixie dust.

categories.title: Who Lives Here?
categories.intro: Knock knock! In this picture category, look at the house and tell me which movie it comes from.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A storybook street of whimsical cottages, a treehouse, a tall stone tower and a balloon-lifted house floating overhead, warm golden light.

clues.clue: Look at this house lifted by balloons! Which movie is it from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Up! [excited] Thousands and thousands of balloons. Adventure is out there!

clues.clue: This tall tower is hidden deep in the forest. Which movie is it from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tangled! [laughs] Eighteen years in one tower. Rapunzel deserved that adventure.

clues.clue: Seven tiny beds are lined up in this cottage. Which movie is it from?
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs! [chuckles] Seven little beds, and a whole lot of dusting to do.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Inside a cosy woodland cottage, seven tiny wooden beds in a row with carved headboards, a stone fireplace, pickaxes by the door and a basket of red apples.

clues.clue: Somebody who loves honey lives in this tree. Which movie is it from?
accept: the many adventures of winnie the pooh
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Winnie the Pooh! [laughs] A silly old bear in the Hundred Acre Wood, with a cupboard full of hunny pots.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A big friendly hollow oak tree in a sunny forest with a round wooden door, a little window, a bell rope and clay honey pots stacked by the entrance, bees buzzing.

clues.clue: This magical house has candles and flowers in every window. Which movie is it from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Encanto! [excited] La Casita can move its tiles and shutters all by itself. A house with personality!

categories.title: My First Park Day
categories.intro: [excited] Time to visit the parks! These are the things every kid spots on their very first day.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny theme park main street with balloons, a spinning teacup ride and a fairy-tale castle at the end of the street, confetti in the air.

clues.clue: The big castle in the middle of Magic Kingdom is named after this princess.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella! [excited] Cinderella Castle stands at the center of the park, and it is always ready for a photo.

clues.clue: EPCOT's giant shiny ball that looks like a huge golf ball is called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spaceship Earth! [laughs] Some people call it the giant golf ball. Inside there is a ride through history.

clues.clue: At Disney's Animal Kingdom, this giant tree is covered in carvings of animals.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tree of Life! Look closely and you'll find hundreds of animals carved all over it.

clues.clue: On this spinning ride, you sit inside giant teacups.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Mad Tea Party! [laughs] Spin the wheel in the middle to go faster. Please don't eat a big lunch first.

clues.clue: On this ride, you fly in circles on the back of an elephant with giant ears.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dumbo the Flying Elephant! [excited] Pull the lever and your elephant flies higher. Ears not included.

categories.title: Emoji Movie Night
categories.intro: Popcorn ready? Look at the emojis and tell me which Disney or Pixar movie they spell out.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cosy living room movie night with a big screen glowing, bowls of popcorn, pillow fort and fairy lights.

clues.clue: 🦁👑🌅 Hint: a cub who just can't wait to be king
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Lion King! [excited] Hakuna matata, my friends.

clues.clue: 🐠🔍🌊 Hint: a dad searching the whole ocean
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Finding Nemo! [laughs] Just keep swimming, just keep swimming.

clues.clue: 🤠🚀🧸 Hint: a cowboy and a space ranger
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Toy Story! To infinity, and beyond!

clues.clue: 🐀👨‍🍳🇫🇷 Hint: anyone can cook
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ratatouille! [chuckles] A rat who cooks, in Paris. Please wash your hands.

clues.clue: 🧞🪔🐒 Hint: three wishes
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [excited] Phenomenal cosmic powers, itty bitty living space.
